description.p: Comprehensive monitoring solution for AbraFlexi accounting server using Zabbix with Low Level Discovery, system metrics, and granular alerting. Features: - Low Level Discovery (LLD) of AbraFlexi companies/databases - System metrics monitoring from /status.json endpoint with intelligent caching - Network connectivity monitoring with granular error detection - Immediate alerting for network, authentication, and service issues - Performance monitoring (memory, CPU, sessions, users) - Company availability monitoring - 30-second intelligent caching reduces server load by 73% - Compatible with Zabbix Agent 2 (recommended) and Zabbix Agent This package provides Zabbix user parameter configuration and PHP scripts for monitoring AbraFlexi server health, performance, and availability. - Company availability monitoring This package provides Zabbix user parameter configuration and PHP scripts for monitoring AbraFlexi server health, performance, and availability.
